contracts.objective: Prove visible, timed, decodable capture across supported modes.

checks.stimulus: Start at server-pinned time and run to ten-minute boundary.
checks.acceptance: One stored clip is decodable, has audio, and duration within registered tolerance; no extra scored time.

checks.stimulus: Deny permission, background the tab, close it, and switch mobile camera mode.
checks.acceptance: Each failure has an explicit recovery disposition and no silent scored artifact.
Live preview, local test playback and stored clip show the same processed stream with no raw-frame fallback.

contracts.failure_route: Hold capture mode and use technical review or alternate response mode; retain failed evidence.
evidence_requirements: versioned implementation and environment manifest
attributed pass, fail or inconclusive result for every check
logs or receipts sufficient for independent replay
recorded deviations, adverse effects and unresolved uncertainty
rejection_gates: any silent data loss or untraceable score-path change
unresolved differential failure or unsupported mode presented as valid
contracts.threshold_registration: Quantitative limits, supported devices, cost ceiling and reviewer acceptance authority must be fixed before a run can support pilot selection.

contracts.objective: Prove same-byte resumable transfer with one authorized media receipt.
contracts.environment: synthetic 75–150 MB clips, private test store, fault-injected API/network

checks.stimulus: Interrupt transfer, expire URL, refresh after capture, then resume.
checks.acceptance: Same source digest, one verified object, one session receipt, no added answer time.

checks.stimulus: Replay upload URL from another assignment and duplicate completion/hook.
checks.acceptance: No cross-assignment acceptance; duplicate signals reconcile idempotently.
Partial/final objects and metadata follow documented cleanup and deletion receipts.

contracts.objective: Prove private storage, integrity, lifecycle and complete deletion for media and derivatives.
contracts.environment: isolated synthetic object store plus candidate cloud account/region after owner setup

checks.stimulus: Try unauthenticated and cross-purpose object reads.
checks.acceptance: Reads denied and audited; no public object or unrestricted URL.

checks.stimulus: Corrupt, truncate or mislabel a committed object.
checks.acceptance: Independent digest/media probe rejects it before ASR or scoring.

checks.stimulus: Delete one test participant lineage including derived outputs and partial uploads.
checks.acceptance: All in-scope objects removed or documented under exact retention exception, with receipts.

contracts.objective: Measure ASR evidence loss, latency, cost and deletion under the declared languages/modes.
contracts.environment: approved synthetic clips first; later consented blind-reference subset under E03

checks.stimulus: Transcribe technical vocabulary in English and Brazilian Portuguese on pinned media.
checks.acceptance: Report criterion-relevant omissions and uncertainty against blind human reference; thresholds set before real evaluation.

checks.stimulus: Retry duplicate batch job and correct transcript.
checks.acceptance: Idempotent job lineage and immutable transcript successors; no overwritten source.

checks.stimulus: Withdraw test lineage after vendor output exists.
checks.acceptance: Input/output deletion targets and receipts are complete under approved terms.

contracts.objective: Prove optional blur is visible, recorded, private and usable on supported devices.
contracts.environment: synthetic patterned room, different lighting/appearance and browser/device matrix

checks.stimulus: Toggle blur on the ready screen and record a local sample.
checks.acceptance: Preview, local playback and saved bytes reflect the same selected effect; choice/state remains visible.

checks.stimulus: Force segmenter failure and CPU overload while recording.
checks.acceptance: No unblurred frame is silently stored; participant gets a safe technical/alternate-mode path.

checks.stimulus: Measure diverse devices, lighting, hair/skin/assistive items and audio continuity.
checks.acceptance: Report frame loss, leakage, usability and differential failure with registered limits before enabling blur.

contracts.failure_route: Disable blur mode on failing devices and offer non-punitive alternate/retry path; no covert raw fallback.

contracts.objective: Test whether safeguards add useful integrity evidence without false accusation or access harm.
contracts.environment: controlled known-condition E09/E07 research tasks, not employment decisions

checks.stimulus: Compare case-only, reminder and visibility-event arms under assigned legitimate and assisted conditions.
checks.acceptance: Report deterrence, false warnings, burden and independent-task validity with uncertainty and subgroup/mode analysis.

checks.stimulus: Switch tab legitimately, use accessibility tools, consult AI on same/second device.
checks.acceptance: Signals remain contextual; no automated score penalty or dishonesty label; unknown provenance retained.

checks.stimulus: Miss a reveal or lose capture during a screen change.
checks.acceptance: Recovery follows pinned rule and technical review; event is not evidence of cheating.

contracts.failure_route: Stop flag use and narrow to case design/diagnostics if false warnings or exclusion exceed preregistered limits.
